title: Margulis-Soifer theorem for one-relator groups
summary: We establish the Margulis-Soifer dichotomy for one-relator groups: every one-relator group is either virtually solvable or has a maximal subgroup of infinite index. We also present examples of one-relator groups with and without free maximal subgroups of infinite index, as well as examples that possess both free and non-free infinite index maximal subgroups. Triviality of the Frattini subgroup is also shown for all non-solvable one-relator groups. We close the paper with a short list of questions.
